name: LLM Gateway — LiteLLM
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway built on LiteLLM. Enforces virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, Bedrock Guardrails, and Langfuse tracing across every model call. Deploys on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Valkey, and a public ALB endpoint. Every agent that talks to Bedrock should route through this one chokepoint.

frameworks.name: Infrastructure Only
frameworks.description: No agent framework — gateway infrastructure only

deployment_patterns.name: LiteLLM on ECS
deployment_patterns.description: ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Valkey, ALB, ECR mirror, SSM-rendered config

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Project name used for resource naming

parameters.name: master_key
parameters.description: LiteLLM admin master key. Stored in Secrets Manager — never echoed back.

parameters.name: enabled_models
parameters.description: Bedrock model IDs / cross-region inference profiles to expose. Default exposes Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Nova Pro/Lite (Claude 3.5 and older are excluded).

parameters.name: attach_guardrail_id
parameters.description: Optional Bedrock Guardrail ID to attach to every gateway request (leave empty to skip)

parameters.name: langfuse_host
parameters.description: Optional Langfuse host URL (from the Foundation Stack output) for trace emission

parameters.name: langfuse_public_key_secret_arn
parameters.description: Secrets Manager ARN holding the Langfuse public key

parameters.name: langfuse_secret_key_secret_arn
parameters.description: Secrets Manager ARN holding the Langfuse secret key

parameters.name: existing_vpc_id
parameters.description: Existing VPC ID to reuse (leave empty to create new — Foundation Stack output recommended)

parameters.name: cognito_user_pool_id
parameters.description: Optional Control Plane Cognito user pool for admin-UI SSO

outputs.gateway_endpoint: Public gateway endpoint. Set this as LITELLM_BASE_URL on every agent.
outputs.master_key_secret_arn: Secrets Manager ARN for the LiteLLM master key
outputs.config_parameter_name: SSM Parameter name holding the rendered LiteLLM config.yaml
outputs.audit_log_group_name: CloudWatch log group holding request + audit logs
outputs.vpc_id: VPC ID the gateway runs in
outputs.private_subnet_ids: Private subnet IDs the gateway tasks attach to
